dedupe_keys.name: dataset on the impact of kredex renovation grants on the energy efficiency of apartment buildings in estonia

description: Elina Bõkovskaja assembled this dataset to study the relationship between KredEx renovation grants and the energy efficiency of Estonian apartment buildings. The sample comes from the Estonian building register and uses each building's latest available energy-performance indicator, expressed in kWh per square metre. Grant records distinguish buildings supported during 2014-2025 whose renovation work was completed. Control variables include construction year, county, enclosed net area, residential land taxable value and population density. District-heating price limits provide a basis for the author's average heat-price calculation. The repository lists an openly accessible Excel workbook under CC BY 4.0 at no stated charge. The data provide building attributes, energy indicators and renovation-policy inputs for building-stock and energy-investment analysis. The metadata do not establish a regular measurement interval, the exact extraction date or causal effects of grants. The supporting description is in Estonian. No directly related catalogue record was confirmed.
